name: Oracle Crystal
summary: The Oracle Crystal is a crafted naga object used by their oracles along Desolace’s coast. Maurin Bonesplitter seeks one as he turns his attention to a demon lord.

sections.title: Naga Craft
sections.body: Maurin Bonesplitter wants an Oracle Crystal from the Slitherblade naga along Desolace’s northwest coast. The naga craft these crystals for their oracles, who dwell among the vast coral reef offshore. Maurin prizes the crystal and means to use it as he searches for the demon lord Azrethoc.

faq.answer: An Oracle Crystal is a crafted object the naga make for their oracles to use.
Maurin Bonesplitter asks for an Oracle Crystal as he pursues the demon lord Azrethoc.

faq.q: Where can I find an Oracle Crystal?
faq.answer: Slitherblade oracles dwell along the northwest coast of Desolace, out in the sea.
The naga craft Oracle Crystals for their oracles to use.
